It's not enough to know “the truth”; Truth, in essence, is the possibility of falsehood. As much as it is utterly faithful to itself, every instance of “the truth” is fatefully false, being the condition of its own negation. Knowing this is enough to Be True, to forget every “truth” and let the essence of Truth be the only guide and principle needed for the Art of Living - to Be True is to rest on no truth, and thus never letting truth cast a shadow of a doubt.
